description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it and Angelic Sell-Sword trigger.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Angelic Sell-Sword trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {U}.
Repeat.
